content.title: "Chaos Rising" English Set Releasing in May! - PokeBeach
content.text: #3 Well, to Mudkip_Master who was trying to guess the name of the set, this was probably one of his first guesses lol #4 Guess you've not seen the leaks Ezmeme #1 Patrat Fan Worldwide | Irl Poison Type #5 I need a Mega Bell in this set and I need it to be playable please please. And even more pressing, a playable Mega Barbaracle because I NEED BARBARACLE BOX. LET BARBAR BOX RULE THE META #6 Let me take a moment to say that if you condone breaking and entering into the printing facilities to steal unreleased cards and leak new sets MONTHS before they're meant to be seen anywhere in the world, all for the sake of manipulating the market and making a quick buck through illegal methods, then you are not welcome on PokeBeach or in ANY TCG community. SUPPORT THE OFFICIAL RELEASE! #7 Wow, I wonder what kinds of new and exciting cards we can expect to see in this set! I'm really looking forward to seeing all the new cards for the very first time over the next few months! #8 I was hoping for Chaos Riptide but I guess it confirm to us those leaks were real #9 I need a Mega Bell in this set and I need it to be playable please please. And even more pressing, a playable Mega Barbaracle because I NEED BARBARACLE BOX. LET BARBAR BOX RULE THE META I just hate the “only 4 megas” rule they’re doing, it’s so annoying… Last edited: Feb 2, 2026 #10 Kinda crazy we already know all the SIRs and some IRs for a May set #11 CRI base being 86 and POR 88, both (likely) only having 4 megas and 6 SIRs… just feel like they were meant to be one singular set for us lol specially with Zygarde and Floette being in separate sets. Good thing is small sets are easier to masterset so not really complaining about it. #12 Wow, I wonder what kinds of new and exciting cards we can expect to see in this set! I'm really looking forward to seeing all the new cards for the very first time over the next few months! Sarcasm? All big cards have been leaked unfortunately, unless you mean playable from main set #13 MEGA GRENINJA LETS GOOOOOO #14 Dang and here I thought it'd be Chilling Reign 2. #15 The highly connected name with Perfect Order reminds me of Breakthrough->Breakpoint, it makes me think that we might start to see a sort of story going between the sets, especially with how many Perfect Order cards were directly tied to Lumiose #16 Complete shot in the dark but I'm guessing we get SIRs of Mega Dragalge/Floette, Cinccino and AZ #17 Complete shot in the dark but I'm guessing we get SIRs of Mega Dragalge/Floette, Cinccino and AZ You think Cinccino? They just did a Normal Type ex with SIR For trainers I’d say AZ too and another popular trainer from Unova but it’s just my guesses too #18 You think Cinccino? They just did a Normal Type ex with SIR For trainers I’d say AZ too and another popular trainer from Unova but it’s just my guesses too my guess is Roxie #19 I predict a crobat art rare #20 Do we think the Krookodile EX and Insurance will be added to this set? [As well as the Toxel and Charmeleon as promos for the blisters]. Not sure I get how long it takes between Gym Promos and international release.
